exposure: maternal diabetes (gestational diabetes mellitus, pregestational diabetes)
outcome: structural cardiac anomalies (atrial septal defect, patent ductus arteriosus, ventricular septal defect)
cohort: 56 neonates born to mothers diagnosed with either gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) or pregestational diabetes between January and December 2023.
finding: A high prevalence (83.9%) of congenital heart anomalies, primarily atrial septal defect (58.9%), was found among infants of diabetic mothers.
mod_finding: No statistically significant association was found between CHD occurrence and type of delivery.
